raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.1.0" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-obistools
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/iobis/obistools/archive/{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7260d7e8773492e82eda82ff0f3eddbf81474c78ce1a216163f1dd8e191fc3de

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}filesystem  # [win]
    - {{ posix }}git
    - {{ posix }}zip         # [win]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-cowplot
    - r-data.tree
    - r-digest
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-httr
    - r-jsonlite
    - r-knitr
    - r-leaflet
    - r-maps
    - r-rappdirs
    - r-rmarkdown
    - r-sf
    - r-stringr
    - r-terra
    - r-tidyr
    - r-worrms
    - r-xml2
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-cowplot
    - r-data.tree
    - r-digest
    - r-dplyr
    - r-ggplot2
    - r-httr
    - r-jsonlite
    - r-knitr
    - r-leaflet
    - r-maps
    - r-rappdirs
    - r-rmarkdown
    - r-sf
    - r-stringr
    - r-terra
    - r-tidyr
    - r-worrms
    - r-xml2

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('obistools')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('obistools')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/iobis/obistools
  summary: Prepare data sets for submission to the Ocean Biogeographical Information System (<http://iobis.org>). It can also be used for checking the quality of a set of marine species distribution records.
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/MIT
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - ocefpaf
